SubtitleDB in every supported player

One call, attachSubtitleDb(player), against a real build of each library. The binding is detected from the object's shape, so nothing on this page names a player twice. Pick one with ?player= or the buttons. Add ?via=cdn&cdn=http://localhost:4174 to run the same mount through the loader from cdn.thesubtitledb.org instead of the vendored package, and &target=element to hand it the media element rather than the player.

The clip is a generated placeholder. Subtitle resolution does not depend on it, which is what the status panel is for.
